title: Balloon Museum Houston Admission
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Step into a world where art comes alive through inflatable installations at the Balloon Museum. This unique experience invites visitors to engage with art in playful and innovative ways. Each exhibition, from Pop Air to Euphoria, showcases vibrant, inflatable creations that inspire creativity and interaction. Whether you're in Houston, Chicago, or Milan, immerse yourself in a celebration of art that encourages exploration and fun. Perfect for families and art enthusiasts alike, the Balloon Museum promises a delightful day out filled with wonder and imagination.
